records.name: Rml::Lua::Interpreter::BeginCall
records.representation: LuaScriptHost.getFunction(name) captures the actual registry function identity. LuaFunction.call/callResults push that reference under a stack scope, preserving it after global replacement, nil assignment and Lua GC.

records.name: Rml::Lua::Interpreter::ExecuteCall
records.representation: LuaFunction.callResults(count,...args) makes one native call, invokes pcall with the exact result count, copies scalar results, pads nil with null and discards extras. Arguments/results obey the actual Lua stack limit. Arbitrary Lua tables, functions and userdata are not scalar return values.

records.name: Rml::Lua::Interpreter::EndCall
records.representation: LuaStackScope automatically restores the exact outer Lua stack after result copy or exceptions. LuaFunction.release separately releases its retained registry reference; it does not expose unsafe caller-directed stack pops.

records.name: Rml::Lua::PushVariant
records.representation: Actual Utilities PushVariant/GetVariant preserve registered native scalar, tuple, aggregate and guarded pointer values in managed Lua. Owned userdata keep native storage/expiry identity and callable closures through actual VM owners; native versus collectible JS roots stay separate. Lua NONE becomes nil; a table becomes native NONE; guarded null pointers remain explicit values. Foreign non-null native opaque/script pointers still require an independently accepted external owner adapter. This evidence accepts only the executed managed VM scope and promotes no unrelated native extension or Core/Supplemental declaration.
